main_text.l: Sanctificatio populi erat, vt ab vxoribus abstiné-
tes, vestes lauarent, in signum studij sanctificationis,
qui essent in tertium diem ad verbum recipiendum
Interdictum de termino ponendo erat, vt termino
posito è populo nullus, nec iumentum, nec homo,
(ne aut lapidibus obruatur aut iaculando conficiantur)
Dei descensus erat in igne, cum summa maiestate &
terrore: ad legis fœderisq; operum terrorem indica-
Maiestas illa se Adiunctis ignis Effectis subseq. indicabat.
Remota, quæ mane cæperunt, soni, fulgura,
Signa adiuncta sunt: Propinqua magis, populo obui am Deo per Moschè edu-ato.

page.notes: The bracketed synopsis and the diagram block in the middle are partly garbled in the scan; the "Sig-na adiuncta sunt" block is read from its bracket layout. Some words (e.g. "Moschè edu-ato", "Interdictum") are doubtful. Show-through text on the right edge is ignored.
